beats.director_line: We enter the call already begun.
beats.action: She steadies the phone at her ear.
beats.performance: Her posture firms; lips press together.

beats.director_line: Hold as the phone voice reshapes her face.
beats.performance: Her eyes lower and glance aside; a small swallow; breath shallow.

beats.director_line: A final beat as the weight settles.
beats.action: She lowers the phone a little.
beats.performance: Her jaw re-sets; eyes flick back toward C01 without a smile.
